tasks.corrected_reference_answer: PyXRefRole.process_link records module/class context, normalizes implicit titles and targets, abbreviates tilde titles, and marks leading-dot references as refspecific (sphinx/domains/python/__init__.py:570-595). tasks.corrected_reference_answer: ASTCharLiteral rejects decoded data unless it has one character, raising UnsupportedMultiCharacterCharLiteral. The parser catches that exception and calls fail with a multiple-decoded-characters diagnostic (sphinx/domains/c/_parser.py:155-165; sphinx/domains/cpp/_parser.py:225-235). This separates construction from user-facing error reporting. The distinction is supported versus unsupported by this AST implementation, not proof that multi-character literals are invalid C/C++ constructs.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: CSVTable.run accesses env only for a file option beginning with a path separator. If that absolute path already exists, it warns and leaves the option unchanged. Otherwise it joins env.srcdir to the option without its first separator, obtains the current document directory via env.doc2path, and rewrites the option using relpath before delegating to the parent directive (sphinx/directives/patches.py:64-82).

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: find_obj has two predictable but different orders. Mode1 tries module.class.name, module.name, bare name, then suffix matches, filtering object types. Mode0 first tries the supplied name exactly, returns no result for an unmatched module reference, then tries class.name, module.name and module.class.name (sphinx/domains/python/__init__.py:886-937). Thus specificity is prioritized only in mode1; mode0 favors an existing exact name. Context-sensitive references select the appropriate mode, rather than a universal most-specific-first rule.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: ASTDeclaratorParen.get_ptr_suffix_id branches on version == 1 and immediately raises NoOldIdError. Statements after that raise in the branch are unreachable, so no version1 concatenation occurs. For other versions the method returns inner.get_ptr_suffix_id(version) + next.get_ptr_suffix_id(version) (sphinx/domains/cpp/_ast.py:3227-3235).

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: ImageDownloader combines a SHA1 of the full URI with a sanitized basename, separating ordinary same-basename URLs while retaining a recognizable filename (sphinx/transforms/post_transforms/images.py:61-76). Repeated identical URIs reuse the path; _download_image uses its timestamp for If-Modified-Since but still sends a request (lines 82-94). This supports conditional reuse, not guaranteed collision impossibility or avoidance of all repeat requests.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: In autosummary, _get_members obtains members, filters requested documenter types and imported-member policy, then asks _skip_member to emit autodoc-skip-member. True excludes, False forces inclusion in both lists, and None includes in all members but uses underscore/include_public rules for the public list (sphinx/ext/autosummary/generate.py:442-457,499-517). Templates consume these lists. This explains autosummary filtering; it is not a guarantee that an excluded member cannot appear through any other documentation directive.
